camera_spec.motion_distribution: camera endpoints and average speeds are clipped Gaussian samples; per-frame motion follows the stored speed_curve, so most moving trajectories have within-clip speed variation
camera_spec.speed_sampling_note: static camera has no translational speed multiplier

physics_spec.description: Sphere falls and bounces under gravity with lateral drift.
physics_spec.sample_model: radius, mass, lateral velocity, friction, and restitution are clipped Gaussian samples.

scene_spec.selection_note: shared by both clips in a pair; varied across pairs

camera_framing_audit.projection_model: approximate pinhole frustum using camera position/look_at/lens; the hard gate requires a continuous full-scene window where every dynamic object center plus a small radius margin is visible, while strict_extent_visible records a more conservative body-extent check
